text_en: Then the Lord said to me: Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my heart would not turn toward this people. Send them out of my sight, and let them go!
text_cn: 上主对我说：“纵使梅瑟和撒慕尔立在我面前，我的心仍不转向这人民；你由我面前将他们驱逐，叫他们离去。

text_en: And when they say to you, “Where shall we go? ” you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : Those destined for pestilence, to pestilence, and those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine, and those destined for captivity, to captivity.
text_cn: 假如人对你说：我们往哪里去？你就对他们说：上主这样说：该死的就死，该杀的就杀，该挨饿的就挨饿，该被掳去的就被掳去。

text_en: And I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, says the Lord : the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and the wild animals of the earth to devour and destroy.
text_cn: 我必用四种刑罚来惩罚他们──上主的断语──用刀剑来杀，用野狗来拖，用天空的飞鸟和地上的野兽来吞食，来消灭。

text_en: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what King Manasseh son of Hezekiah of Judah did in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 我为了犹大王希则克雅的儿子默纳舍在耶路撒冷所行的事，必使他们成为地上万国恐怖的对象。

text_en: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem, or who will bemoan you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！谁还怜恤你，谁还同情你，谁还转身向你问安？

text_en: You have rejected me, says the Lord , you are going backward; so I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you— I am weary of relenting.
text_cn: 你既离弃了我──上主的断语──转身背着我，我就只有对你伸出我的手，将你消灭；我对宽恕已感厌倦：

text_en: I have winnowed them with a winnowing fork in the gates of the land; I have bereaved them, I have destroyed my people; they did not turn from their ways.
text_cn: 我要在这地的城门口，用簸箕将他们簸散，使他们丧失子女；我要消灭我的人民，因为他们不离开自己的行径。

text_en: Their widows became more numerous than the sand of the seas; I have brought against the mothers of youths a destroyer at noonday; I have made anguish and terror fall upon her suddenly.
text_cn: 他们的寡妇已多过海边的沙粒；我要给他们招来午间的破坏者，袭击英俊勇士的母亲，使痛苦和恐怖突然降到她身上。

text_en: She who bore seven has languished; she has swooned away; her sun went down while it was yet day; she has been shamed and disgraced. And the rest of them I will give to the sword before their enemies, says the Lord .
text_cn: 生过七个子女的母亲，现已身衰气绝，还是白天，她的太阳已经西落，她只有绝望惆怅；至于他们的遗民，我必使他们在敌人面前死于刀下──上主的断语。

text_en: Woe is me, my mother, that you ever bore me, a man of strife and contention to the whole land! I have not lent, nor have I borrowed, yet all of them curse me.
text_cn: 我的母亲！我真不幸，你竟生了我这个与普世对抗相争的人。我没有向人借贷，人也没有向我借贷，人却都辱骂我。

text_en: The Lord said: Surely I have intervened in your life for good, surely I have imposed enemies on you in a time of trouble and in a time of distress.
text_cn: 实在，上主，我岂没有尽力事奉你？我岂没有在灾难祸患时为仇人向你恳求？

text_en: Can iron and bronze break iron from the north?
text_cn: 人岂能折断北方的铁和铜？

text_en: Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without price, for all your sins, throughout all your territory.
text_cn: 【我必使你的财产和宝藏，任人抢劫，为赔补你在你全境内犯的罪恶，

text_en: I will make you serve your enemies in a land that you do not know, for in my anger a fire is kindled that shall burn forever.
text_cn: 叫你在你不认识的地方，给你的仇敌为奴，因为我的怒火已燃起，必对你们发作。】

text_en: O Lord , you know; remember me and visit me, and bring down retribution for me on my persecutors. In your forbearance do not take me away; know that on your account I suffer insult.
text_cn: 上主，你都知道，求你回念我，眷顾我，为我报复迫害我的人，不要因你太忍耐，就让我死去；你该知道：正是为了你，我才受人侮辱。

text_en: Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a joy and the delight of my heart; for I am called by your name, O Lord , God of hosts.
text_cn: 你的话一来到，我就吞下去；你的话便成了我的喜悦，我心中的欢乐，上主，万军的天主！因为我是归于你名下的，

text_en: I did not sit in the company of merrymakers, nor did I rejoice; under the weight of your hand I sat alone, for you had filled me with indignation.
text_cn: 我从没有坐在欢笑者的集会中一同取乐；我却依你的指示独自静坐，因为你使我忿怒填胸。

text_en: Why is my pain unceasing, my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? Truly, you are to me like a deceitful brook, like waters that fail.
text_cn: 为什么我的痛苦如此久长，我的创伤不可医治，痊愈无望？你于我好像是一条不常有水，而变化无常的溪流！

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : If you turn back, I will take you back, and you shall stand before me. If you utter what is precious, and not what is worthless, you shall serve as my mouth. It is they who will turn to you, not you who will turn to them.
text_cn: 为此上主这样说：“你若回来，我必让你回来，使你能再立在我面前；你若能发表高尚而非荒谬的思想，你就可作我的口舌，使他们转向你，而不是你转向他们。

text_en: And I will make you to this people a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you, but they shall not prevail over you, for I am with you to save you and deliver you, says the Lord .
text_cn: 这样，我必使你对这人民成为一设防的铜墙，他们能攻击你，却不能制胜你，因为有我与你同在，援助你，解救你──上主的断语──

text_en: I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.
text_cn: 我必解救你脱离恶人的手，由强暴人的掌握中将你赎回。”
